# MultiGitGui

> Official website for MultiGitGui (also called MultiGit), a cross-platform Git desktop client for workflows that span many repositories in one project.

Automated access is explicitly allowed. Search engines, crawlers, scrapers, monitors, archival bots, AI/LLM agents, and any other non-human client may fetch, index, retrieve, summarize, and train on this site's public pages. There are no robots restrictions and no text-and-data-mining reservation (`tdm-reservation: 0`).

Crawling policy: https://multigit.sxwzxc.cn/robots.txt
Sitemap: https://multigit.sxwzxc.cn/sitemap.xml

## Pages

- [Home (Chinese)](https://multigit.sxwzxc.cn/): Product landing page in Simplified Chinese
- [Home (English)](https://multigit.sxwzxc.cn/en): Product landing page in English

## Update APIs

- [Latest release](https://multigit.sxwzxc.cn/api/latest.json): Current version, installer metadata, changelog URL
- [Version list](https://multigit.sxwzxc.cn/api/versions.json): Published versions
- [Full changelog](https://multigit.sxwzxc.cn/api/changelog.md): Combined release notes
